0.0: Hi there. #b#h0##k, hero of the mighty Mushking Empire. Before you leave the Empire, I'd like to make one more request for you.
0.1: Of course, you'll be rewarded for your work. If you can take care of this, I'll give you one of the #bKing Pepe's Weapon Scrolls#k that our patrolmen found.

yes.0: Okay, thanks for taking up the offer. It's about eliminating the remaining minions of #bKing Pepe's#k army. I'd like for you to eliminate some of them while our army is being gathered. We can take care of the rest after that.

no.0: If you are busy, then that's okay. You can always come back and help us down the road.

1.0: Did you manage to defeat them already? You really are something!

yes.0: Please put it to good use.

mob.0: I don't think you have taken care of enough of those enemies. Please eliminate more of them.
